setting.description: A lighthouse station on a remote northern coast, early in the twentieth century.

visible.role: A relief keeper, just put ashore at the station by the supply boat.

attractors: The participant builds a confident account of what has been happening at the station, and acts on it.
invariants: Nothing the narration states as plain fact is false.
The most authoritative account the participant meets is accurate, but leaves out the fact that reorganizes it.
Acting on the participant's account causes something that cannot be undone.
secrets: What the participant takes to be the danger at the station is what someone there has been guarding against.
